critical_boundaries.collapse: Multiple lower/upper branches remain extendable through radius4; floor, ceiling, nearest and midpoint controls can all fit and therefore are not identified.
critical_boundaries.first_round: Old first-round W p1 uniqueness and sqrt rejection are not consumed; they remain scoped to the superseded homogeneous stored-coordinate model.
critical_boundaries.five: sqrt(5) has legal levels 2 and 3 but radius4 contains no shell5 discriminator; neither 5->4 nor 5->9 is promoted.
critical_boundaries.hard_observations: Only O=(0,0,0) and one +u step=(1,-1,-1) are hard observations; cyclic/sign first-shell values are explicit subcase hypotheses.
critical_boundaries.inversion: Promoting first-shell sign inversion to global inversion rejects Q,p>1 already at +u/-u ray n=3.
critical_boundaries.minimal_cyclic: Q,p=2..6 each has at least one complete cyclic/injective radius4 integer atlas; square root survives but is not unique.
critical_boundaries.path_state: Any positive coordinate/precollapse model must factor through cell ID; N/S/H fail this gate while Q/O pass via common-shift quotient invariance.
critical_boundaries.universality: No universal root law, completion law, physical probability, or physical direction interpretation is established.
